# Interactive Tools for Exploring SLC's Flight Network and Weather

This page provides access to three companion Shiny apps for the November 6, 2026, R Govys webinar, *Using R to Track Flights and Weather Across Salt Lake City's Flight Network*. The apps were developed by [Aleksey Kulyukin](https://orcid.org/0009-0009-4396-9878) at [Utah State University](https://www.usu.edu/)’s [Department of Mathematics & Statistics](https://artsci.usu.edu/math-stats/). They support interactive exploration of airport connections, flight-volume patterns, and the availability of weather observations across SLC's flight network.

:::::: grid

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### SLC Flight Network Explorer

Explore airports connected to Salt Lake City over time. Examine the flight network across years, including routes, airlines, and airport connections.

[Launch app](https://9ixde5-aleksey-kulyukin.shinyapps.io/slc-flight-network-2/){.btn .btn-primary}

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### SLC Flight Volume Explorer

Examine daily flight activity at Salt Lake City for both main and diverted flights. Explore flight-volume patterns and unusually large diversion activity.

[Launch app](https://9ixde5-aleksey-kulyukin.shinyapps.io/slc-flight-volume-2/){.btn .btn-primary}

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### SLC Airport & Weather Station Explorer

Explore weather stations associated with airports in Salt Lake City's flight network. Examine how station relationships and the availability of daily and hourly weather reports vary over time.

[Launch app](https://9ixde5-aleksey-kulyukin.shinyapps.io/slc-weather-explorer/){.btn .btn-primary}

:::

::::::
